items.criterion: 1) README CI/CD job count and list match the jobs defined in .github/workflows/ci.yml (both lists derived and diffed, evidence pasted); 2) every README job bullet names an existing job and every ci.yml job is documented or explicitly noted; 3) grep -rn test_command README.md docs/ returns no citation of a nonexistent config key; 4) paste the ci.yml extraction, README extraction and grep output.
items.detail: ci.yml job-id extraction (python, 2-space keys under `jobs:`): 7 jobs — build:11, transport-retry-selftest:86, deploy-gate-selftest:104, binary-seed-probe:143, corpus-hygiene:180, readme-release-pin:209, golangci-lint:227. README.md:597 states "seven jobs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`build`, `transport-retry-selftest`, `deploy-gate-selftest`, `binary-seed-probe`, `corpus-hygiene`, `readme-release-pin`, `golangci-lint`), listed below in file order" — identical set, identical order. README extraction (lines 599-605, `- **` bullets) yields exactly 7 bullets, one per job, same order: 599 `Test (short)` (`build`) -> ci.yml:11/74; 600 Transport retry self-test -> ci.yml:87; 601 Deploy gate self-test -> ci.yml:105; 602 Binary seed probe -> ci.yml:144; 603 Corpus host-path hygiene -> ci.yml:181; 604 README release pin (`readme-release-pin`) -> ci.yml:210/209; 605 golangci-lint -> ci.yml:228/227. No README bullet names a nonexistent job and no ci.yml job is undocumented. `grep -rn "test_command" README.md docs/` -> no output, EXIT=1 (the stale citation at docs/agents-harness-guard.md:28-29 was replaced by the real keys). All three artifacts (ci.yml extraction, README extraction, grep output) were produced and diffed in this review. The commit under review is 41176e33 (README.md +5/-2, docs/agents-harness-guard.md +10/-2), merged at 32c1fc71. [resolution 0.08; .github/workflows/ci.yml, ci.yml, README.md]

items.criterion: The config keys cited in docs/agents-harness-guard.md (guards.test_mode, guards.tests, guards.go.tests, guards.go.build) must exist in .gitreins/config.yaml with the stated values, and the doc must not claim a command/interpreter override exists.
items.detail: .gitreins/config.yaml contains `guards.test_mode: full`, `guards.tests: false`, `guards.go.build: true`, `guards.go.tests: true` — exactly the values docs/agents-harness-guard.md:29-30 asserts. Full read of the config shows no command/interpreter override key of any kind (only guards.*, evaluator.*, defaults.*, history.*), so the doc's claim "The file contains no command or interpreter override of any kind" is true, and the built-in invocation it names (`go test -short -count=1 ./...`) matches the README gate table at README.md:593.

items.criterion: The README CI/CD prose must not assert a trigger that ci.yml does not define (push branches, PR branches, tag patterns) and must not assert a Go version that differs from go.mod / ci.yml.
items.detail: ci.yml:4-9 defines push branches [master] + tags ['v*'] and pull_request branches [master]; README.md:597 says "every push to `master`, on every PR, and on `v*` tag pushes" — matches. README.md:599 claims the single-leg matrix is pinned to Go 1.26.11, "the exact `go.mod` patch"; go.mod:3 is `go 1.26.11` and ci.yml:20 pins `go-version: ['1.26.11']` — matches (the pre-change text said "Go 1.26", which was the drift this task fixed).
